1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.CutTreeTriangleCoverage
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.SmallPolyhedronCutEdgeTriangles
3 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.SmallPolyhedronCutTreeRadialPartition
4 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.SmallPolyhedronCutTreeStripDensity
5 
6 /-! The finitely many closed radial triangles cover the actual whole
7 boundary, including all exceptional rays and cut points. This coverage
8 does not identify the distinct copies needed in a later cut surface.
9 
10 Here the shortest-route inputs come from the actual vertex fans of a
11 polyhedron with at most six vertices and triangular/quadrilateral faces.
12 No canonical graph model is assumed. -/
13 
14 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
15 
16 open Set
17 
18 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (size : P.vertices.card ≤ 6)
19   (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
20     (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
21 
22 include size small_faces in
23 /-- Any choices of the actual paired developments cover the entire boundary. -/
24 theorem small_cut_tree_triangles_cover (a : frontier P.body) (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
25     (triangles : (d : T.graph.Dart) → CutEdgeTriangles T d.adj) (b : frontier P.body) :
26     ∃ d, b ∈ range (closedRouteStripMap (triangles d).first) ∪
27       range (closedRouteStripMap (triangles d).second) := by
28   classical
29   letI : Fintype T.vertices := T.finite_vertices.fintype
30   let covered : Set (frontier P.body) := ⋃ d,
31     range (closedRouteStripMap (triangles d).first) ∪ range (closedRouteStripMap (triangles d).second)
32   have closed : IsClosed covered := isClosed_iUnion_of_finite (fun d =>
33     (isCompact_range (closedRouteStripMap (triangles d).first).continuous).isClosed.union
34       (isCompact_range (closedRouteStripMap (triangles d).second).continuous).isClosed)
35   have included : {x : frontier P.body | x ≠ a ∧ x ∉ P.cutSet a ∧ x ∉ T.vertexRays} ⊆ covered := by
36     intro x hx
37     rcases small_cut_tree_radial_partition size small_faces a T
38         (fun u v edge => (triangles ⟨(u, v), edge⟩).strips) x with
39       source | cut | ray | ⟨u, v, edge, inside⟩
40     · exact (hx.1 source).elim
41     · exact (hx.2.1 cut).elim
42     · exact (hx.2.2 ray).elim
43     · apply mem_iUnion.mpr
44       refine ⟨⟨(u, v), edge⟩, ?_⟩
45       rcases inside with first | second
46       · left
47         rw [← closure_routeStrip_eq _ _ (fun t => (triangles ⟨(u, v), edge⟩).agrees t |>.1)]
48         exact subset_closure first
49       · right
50         rw [← closure_routeStrip_eq _ _ (fun t => (triangles ⟨(u, v), edge⟩).agrees t |>.2)]
51         exact subset_closure second
52   have all := closure_minimal included closed
53   rw [(small_cut_tree_strip_points_dense size small_faces a T).closure_eq] at all
54   exact mem_iUnion.mp (all (mem_univ b))
55 
56 include size small_faces in
57 /-- Choose all actual paired developments simultaneously, with complete surface coverage. -/
58 theorem small_exists_cut_tree_triangle_cover (a : frontier P.body) (T : P.CutLocusTree a) :
59     ∃ triangles : (d : T.graph.Dart) → CutEdgeTriangles T d.adj,
60       ∀ b : frontier P.body, ∃ d,
61         b ∈ range (closedRouteStripMap (triangles d).first) ∪
62           range (closedRouteStripMap (triangles d).second) := by
63   classical
64   let triangles (d : T.graph.Dart) : CutEdgeTriangles T d.adj :=
65     Classical.choice (small_exists_cut_edge_triangles size small_faces a T d.adj)
66   exact ⟨triangles, small_cut_tree_triangles_cover size small_faces a T triangles⟩
67 
68 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
